description: 🚀 Azmar is a Kurdish technology team passionate about AI, NASA data, software, and solving real-world problems. For Field Shift, we aim to use Earth-observation data and AI to help farmers make smarter decisions about crops, water, soil, and climate. We welcome developers, AI/data scientists, GIS experts, agriculture specialists, UI/UX designers, and great storytellers. 🌱🛰️
